title: Ships before steam: the trade-wind highways of the age of sail, drawn from real logbooks
excerpt: 6,524 passages from British, Dutch, Spanish and French ships' logbooks, 1750 to 1850. Drawn as lines, they show ships running out with the trade winds, looping home past the Azores and racing east through the roaring forties to Java.
seo_description: Real ships' logbooks from 1750 to 1850 drawn as voyage lines: the trade winds, the volta do mar, the Brouwer route and how long voyages took.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Ships before steam' beside a world map of thousands of thin voyage lines coloured by nation, red British, orange Dutch, gold Spanish and blue French, crowding the Atlantic, rounding the Cape and crossing the southern Indian Ocean to Java. Text: 6,524 passages from real logbooks, 1662 to 1855.
